ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

2. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

3. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 2

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 41
   C. 31
   D. 43

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 9

8. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 13
   C. 5
   D. 9

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

10. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 6

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

12. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 9 × 9
3. Area = 81
Final Answer: 81 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 40
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 5
3. Product = 40
Final Answer: 40
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

3. B — 24
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 6
3. Product = 24
Final Answer: 24
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

4. B — 41
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 40²
3. c² = 81 + 1600
4. c² = 1681
5. c = 41
Final Answer: 41 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

5. B — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

6. A — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

7. A — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

8. A — 4
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 13 − 9
3. x = 4
Final Answer: x = 4
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

9. D — 10 000 m²

10. B — 1, 2, 3, 6

11. C — 49
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7
3. 7² = 49
Final Answer: 49
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

12. C — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 9
3. Product = 36
Final Answer: 36
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer
